checks.label: copy-reorder
checks.expression: (async()=>{const wait=async(test)=>{const end=Date.now()+1500;while(!test()){if(Date.now()>end)return false;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}return true;};const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll("li")];rows[0].querySelector("button").click();if(!await wait(()=>rows[0].querySelector("span").textContent==="Ari: 1"))return false;document.querySelector("button").click();return await wait(()=>document.querySelectorAll("li")[1]===rows[0]&&rows[0].querySelector("span").textContent==="Ari: 1");})()

checks.label: changed-initial-toggle
checks.expression: (async()=>{const wait=async(test)=>{const end=Date.now()+1500;while(!test()){if(Date.now()>end)return false;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}return true;};const b=document.querySelector("button");if(b.textContent!=="On")return false;b.click();return await wait(()=>b.textContent==="Off");})()

checks.label: complete-boundary-companion
checks.expression: (async()=>{const wait=async(test)=>{const end=Date.now()+1500;while(!test()){if(Date.now()>end)return false;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}return true;};return await wait(()=>document.querySelector("p")?.textContent==="Try again later");})()

checks.label: controlled-lazy-worked
checks.expression: (async()=>{const wait=async(test)=>{const end=Date.now()+1500;while(!test()){if(Date.now()>end)return false;await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10));}return true;};if(!await wait(()=>document.querySelector("[role=status]")?.textContent==="Preparing greeting"))return false;if(document.querySelector("[data-greeting]"))return false;document.querySelector("button").click();return await wait(()=>document.querySelector("[data-greeting]")?.textContent==="Hello, explorer"&&!document.querySelector("[role=status]"));})()
